name: node-red-augmencia
description: Communicate with Augmencia's API using Node-RED

scripts.start-container: docker run -d -p 1880:1880 -v .:/augmencia -v ./node_red_data:/data -v ./gcodes:/gcodes -v ./sdcard:/sdcard --name node-red-augmencia nodered/node-red && docker exec -w /data node-red-augmencia npm install /augmencia
scripts.start-demo-container: docker run -d -p 1880:1880 -v .:/augmencia --privileged -v ./node_red_data:/data -v ./gcodes:/gcodes -v "/Volumes/NO NAME:/sdcard" --name node-red-augmencia nodered/node-red && docker exec -w /data node-red-augmencia npm install /augmencia
scripts.debug: npm run start-container && nodemon --ignore node_red_data --ext html,js,json,proto --exec 'npm run restart-container';npm run stop-container
scripts.demo: npm run start-demo-container && nodemon --ignore node_red_data --ext html,js,json,proto --exec 'npm run restart-container';npm run stop-container

author: augmencia.com
